title: Petals and Vines Boutique Craft Café
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Unlike traditional art classes, here you choose your own creative adventure.

Located inside a charming boutique at The Shops at Mallory Square, this one-of-a-kind experience combines crafting, shopping, and the relaxed atmosphere of Key West. Guests can select from a rotating menu of hands-on projects, including pressed floral bookmarks, decoupage teacups and saucers, decorative birdhouses, seasonal crafts, and more.

No two visits are the same. With new projects introduced regularly, there's always something fresh to create.
